title.zh: 日报直接给出要领 tBNB 的地址
title.en: The daily report now names the tBNB claim address

summary.zh: 水龙头有验证码，只有人能过，而且只服务在 BSC 主网上持币的那一个地址。日报因此每天列出领取地址、水龙头链接、可动用余额、实测日耗与预计续航，并直接给出今天要不要去领。
summary.en: The faucet is captcha-gated, so only a person can work it, and it serves only the one address that already holds BNB on BSC mainnet. The report now prints that address, the faucet link, spendable balance, measured daily burn and runway every morning, and says outright whether today is a day to claim.

zh: 领取地址是 gas 加注账户，也是五个运营账户里唯一满足水龙头主网门槛的那个。报告用一次只读的主网余额查询现场核对；一旦跌破门槛就转红并说明水龙头会拒绝，免得在浏览器里撞上一句没有解释的拒绝。这个进程在任何链上都不签名。
日耗是测出来的：每次运行记录运营账户总余额，下一次用差值除以间隔时间，因此续航跟随真实的回合节奏与 gas 价格，而不是一个会过期的常数。跑满两次之前、以及刚补过币之后显示「暂无」——余额变多是没测到，不是负消耗。
任何账户跌破下限都会直接要求领取，不管续航算出来是多少；续航未知也不当作没事。
en: The claim address is the gas funder, the only one of the five operational accounts that meets the faucet's mainnet requirement. The report verifies this live with a single read-only balance read and turns the line red if it ever falls short, so the faucet refusing a claim is never an unexplained surprise in a browser. This process signs nothing, on any chain.

The burn rate is measured rather than assumed: each run records the total operational balance and the next divides the difference by the elapsed time, so runway follows the real round cadence and gas price instead of a constant that goes stale. It reads as unavailable until two runs exist, and again after any top-up, because a rising balance is a missing measurement rather than a negative burn.
Any account below its floor asks for a claim outright, whatever the runway arithmetic says, and an unknown runway is never treated as fine.

title.zh: 没有成交的市场不再算故障
title.en: A market with no trades is no longer treated as a fault

summary.zh: 每日报告原本把「其余市场照常成交、这个市场一个回合都没开出来」判为 keeper 卡住。这个判断是错的：时间格只有在有人下注时才会变成回合，所以回合为零永远等于需求为零。现在它改为在 各市场 下以「无成交」一行列出，健康结论不再因此转红。
summary.en: The daily report treated a market that produced no rounds while its siblings traded as a stuck keeper. That inference was wrong: a grid slot only becomes a round once somebody bets, so zero rounds always means zero demand. Such markets are now named on a 无成交 line under 各市场, and the health verdict no longer turns red for them.

zh: 回合的诞生取决于下注，不取决于 keeper：`_activateBettableRound` 在第一笔下注时把时间格写成回合，而 keeper 只结算下注撑起来的回合。因此「没有回合」无法区分停摆与无人下注，真正的 keeper 故障会以另一种形式出现——有资金的回合没能按时结算，那一行本来就已经是红的。
空的市场会被点名而不是从表里删掉：行消失之后，「消失的行」和「没人碰过的市场」看起来完全一样。整块盘口都没有成交时不再重复提示，因为报告最上面已经用一行说过了。
en: Round creation is driven by bets, not by the keeper: `_activateBettableRound` turns a grid slot into a round on the first bet, and the keeper only settles rounds a bet funded. So "no rounds" cannot separate an outage from an empty order book, while a genuine keeper failure surfaces differently — as a funded round that missed its settlement window, which already has its own red line.

Empty markets are named rather than dropped from the per-market table, because once the row is gone a missing row and a market nobody touched look identical. When no market traded at all the line is suppressed, since the top of the report has already said so.

summary.zh: 每天早上通过 Telegram 发送一份前一自然日的链上报告：六个 chain-97 市场的下注、回合与手续费，真实用户下注与项目自有做市资金分开计量，未按时结算而全额退款的回合单独标出。
summary.en: A Telegram report each morning covers the previous calendar day on chain: stake, rounds, and fees across the six chain-97 markets, with real-user stake counted separately from the project's own market-making liquidity and rounds refunded because they never settled in time called out on their own line.

zh: 真实用户下注＝六个市场上非内部地址投入的金额，内部地址（做市 bot、keeper/operator、owner、gas 加注账户）单列且不计入。链上视图没有全局下注地址索引，因此只统计下注额与参与回合数，不报去重用户数；漏列的内部地址只会被算进真实用户一侧，所以这个数字是下限而非高估。
有资金却未按时结算、被全额退款的回合，以及已过截止时间、资金可退但尚未有人触发的回合，各自用 🔴 单独一行标出；平局与单边无对手的退款按设计另行列示，两者都不收手续费。
全部读自合约视图：公共 BSC 测试网节点直接拒绝 eth_getLogs，而 chain 97 一天约 19.2 万个区块，没有免费节点会返回这么大的范围。回合由 epoch 网格算出、经 Multicall3 批量读取，一天加上环比对比约 73 秒读完。
每次发送都重新核对六个市场的偿付能力（USDT 余额 ≥ 待兑付用户资金 + 未提取手续费）、keeper 与 bot 的 gas 下限，以及 keeper /healthz，任一不通过则健康行转为 🔴。自然日边界固定为 UTC+08，与 keeper 主机时区无关；已发送日期落盘，重启或补跑不会把同一天发第二遍。
en: Real-user stake is what non-internal addresses put up across the six markets, with the internal accounts — the market-making bots, keeper/operator, owner, and gas funder — on a line of their own and excluded from it. Contract views carry no global index of bettors, so the report counts stake and participating rounds rather than unique addresses; an internal address left off the list can only land on the real-user side, which makes the figure a floor rather than an overcount.

Funded rounds refunded in full because they never settled in time, and funded rounds already past their deadline that nobody has voided yet, each get their own 🔴 line; tie and one-sided refunds are listed separately as the by-design outcomes they are, and neither takes a fee.

Everything is read from contract views: the public BSC testnet nodes reject eth_getLogs outright, and chain 97 produces roughly 192k blocks a day, a range no free endpoint will serve. Rounds are derived from the epoch grid and read in batches through Multicall3, so a day plus its day-over-day comparison takes about 73 seconds.

Every send re-checks solvency for all six markets (USDT balance ≥ outstanding user funds + unwithdrawn fees), the keeper and bot gas floors, and keeper /healthz, turning the health line red if any of them fails. The calendar-day boundary is fixed at UTC+08 rather than the keeper host's timezone, and the last delivered date is written to disk so a restart or catch-up run cannot send the same day twice.

title.zh: keeper 健康与看门狗修复

summary.zh: keeper 现在能报告一个从不执行却始终显示绿色的自身；看门狗会核对 keeper 服务的合约地址，并修正恢复通知的文案；做市 bot 不再每 10 秒重复读取合约常量。
summary.en: The keeper now reports itself when it never executes yet stays green; the watchdog checks which contracts the keeper serves and no longer misstates recovery; the market-making bot stops re-reading a contract constant every ten seconds.

zh: 连续两个有资金的活跃时段过去而 keeper 一次都没有执行时，该市场报告为 degraded：有资金的时段在 lockTs + bufferSeconds 结束，短于两个 interval 的 stale 预算，此前一个从不执行的 keeper 会一直保持绿色，每一轮都作废退款。只有链上时间已过截止点才计数，状态在下一次成功执行、keeper 重启或六小时后清除。
/healthz 的每个市场行现在带合约地址，独立看门狗会逐一与 DEPLOYMENTS_PATH 中的部署清单比对，仍在服务已替换旧合约的 keeper 进程会告警，而不是因名称和状态相同而通过。早于本次发布的旧版 keeper 不上报地址、无法核对：看门狗会记录这一点，并在其未经核对运行超过宽限期（默认 10 分钟）后告警。
恢复通知发送失败时，看门狗保留故障告警已送达的记录，后续成功的恢复通知不再附带“故障告警未送达”的错误说明。
FIRST_BET_MIN_LEAD_SECONDS 是编译进每个市场合约的常量，bot 现在每个市场只读取一次，六个市场每分钟减少约 36 次公共 RPC 调用。
en: A market whose funded spells pass twice in a row without the keeper executing once is reported degraded: a funded spell ends at lockTs + bufferSeconds, under the two-interval stale budget, so a keeper that never executed used to stay green while every round voided into refunds. A spell counts only once chain time is past that deadline, and the state clears on the next executed round, on a keeper restart, or after six hours.

Each /healthz market row now carries its contract address, and the independent watchdog compares every one with the deployment manifest at DEPLOYMENTS_PATH, so a keeper process still serving superseded contracts alerts instead of passing on identical names and states. A keeper build predating this release reports no addresses and cannot be checked: the watchdog notes that, and alerts once it has run unverified past the grace period (ten minutes by default).
When a recovery notice fails to send, the watchdog keeps the record that the failure alert was delivered, so a later successful recovery notice no longer carries a false undelivered qualifier.
FIRST_BET_MIN_LEAD_SECONDS is a constant compiled into each market contract; the bot now reads it once per market, saving about 36 public RPC calls a minute across six markets.

title.zh: 连续轮次与故障告警修复

summary.zh: 做市 bot 现在能唤醒虚拟空轮次，并在 keeper 已活跃时持续为后续轮次提供盘口；独立 watchdog 会通过 Telegram 报告 keeper 或测试网 gas 故障及恢复。
summary.en: The market-making bot can now wake virtual empty rounds and keep successor rounds funded while the keeper is active; an independent watchdog reports keeper or testnet-gas failures and recovery through Telegram.

zh: 只有真正休眠的空盘首注需要保留 50 秒中继余量；已有结算任务使 keeper 保持活跃时，下一轮仍可正常接收首注。
prod watchdog 每分钟独立检查六个市场、keeper、两个做市 bot 与 gas 资金账户，并发送首次故障、定时提醒和恢复通知。
六个 BSC 测试网市场已迁移到修复后的新合约，11 份合约源码全部通过 Sourcify 验证。
en: Only a genuinely dormant empty book reserves the 50-second relay runway; when settlement work already keeps the keeper active, the successor round can accept its first stake normally.
The production watchdog independently checks all six markets, the keeper, both market-making bots, and the gas funder every minute, sending first-failure, reminder, and recovery notifications.
All six BSC testnet markets moved to the corrected contracts, with all 11 deployed contracts source-verified by Sourcify.

title.zh: 空盘无需 keeper gas 也会正常开盘
title.en: Empty markets open without keeper gas

summary.zh: 没有任何下注时，六个市场的空轮次现在会沿固定时间网格自动开盘，不再依赖 keeper 余额或持续链上交易。
summary.en: When nobody has bet, empty rounds across all six markets now open automatically on the fixed time grid without depending on keeper balance or recurring on-chain transactions.

zh: 空轮次保持虚拟开盘；第一笔真实下注才把轮次写上链并唤醒 keeper。
测试网空盘首注保留 50 秒的完整三路中继余量；已有资金的轮次仍按原锁盘时间接收下注。
六个 BSC 测试网市场和常在线 keeper 已切换到新合约，空盘健康检查现在保持为绿色。
en: Empty rounds remain virtually open; the first real stake materializes the round and wakes the keeper.
A dormant testnet first stake reserves 50 seconds for the full three-feed relay path; funded rounds retain their normal betting deadline.
All six BSC testnet markets and the always-on keeper have moved to the replacement contracts, with empty-market health now staying green.

title.zh: 市场执行服务迁移至常在线环境
title.en: Market execution moves to an always-on environment

summary.zh: 1 分钟与 10 分钟市场的 keeper 已迁移至常在线生产环境，并由当前六个市场的健康检查持续监控。
summary.en: The keeper for the one- and ten-minute markets now runs in an always-on production environment with health checks bound to the current six markets.

zh: 执行服务不再依赖会休眠的本地电脑，降低错过定价与结算边界的风险。
因执行窗口超时而作废的轮次仍按合约规则全额退款，不收取手续费。
en: Market execution no longer depends on a local computer that can sleep, reducing the risk of missed pricing and settlement boundaries.
Rounds voided after an execution-window timeout remain fully refundable under the contract rules, with no fee.

title.zh: 常见问题新增联系方式

summary.zh: 常见问题现在直接列出官方 X / Twitter 主页，用户可以更容易地联系团队并关注公开更新。
summary.en: The FAQ now lists the official X / Twitter profile directly, making it easier to contact the team and follow public updates.

zh: 新增“联系我们”栏目，并提供可直接打开的官方主页 @BluffKingAI。
移动端历史记录的“核验”结果会避开固定页头，打开后可立即看到。
en: Added a Contact us section with a direct link to the official @BluffKingAI profile.
History verification results now clear the sticky mobile header and remain visible when opened.

title.zh: 1 分钟与 10 分钟市场上线
title.en: One- and ten-minute markets are live

summary.zh: BTC、ETH、BNB 现在各提供 1 分钟与 10 分钟两个 USDT 结算档位，测试网运行与领取指引也同步加固。
summary.en: BTC, ETH, and BNB now each offer one- and ten-minute USDT-settled markets, alongside stronger testnet operations and funding guidance.

zh: 审查流程现在会在跨厂商 reviewer 返回结构化额度耗尽后，自动切换到固定的同厂商独立模型，并明确记录 cross_vendor=false。
手机端市场选择器改为自动换行网格，六个市场不再产生页面横向滚动或裁切。
六个市场已迁移到新的 BSC 测试网合约，并全部通过源码验证。
keeper 以更适合 1 分钟边界的节奏运行，下注账户增加低余额与 24 小时主动补充检查。
页面直接提供 BNB Chain 官方 tBNB 水龙头，并新增中英文更新记录。
en: The review workflow now switches to a pinned same-vendor independent model after structured opposite-vendor quota exhaustion, recording cross_vendor=false explicitly.
The mobile market picker now wraps into a responsive grid, removing page-level horizontal scrolling and clipped markets.
All six markets moved to newly deployed BSC testnet contracts with verified source code.
The keeper now runs on a cadence sized for one-minute boundaries, while betting accounts gain low-balance and 24-hour proactive refill checks.
The site links directly to BNB Chain’s official tBNB faucet and now includes bilingual release notes.
